summary: Costco filed an 8-K announcing its quarterly cash dividend of $1.47 per share, declared July 7, 2026, payable August 7, 2026, to holders of record July 24, 2026. This is a routine capital return event, not an M&A or restructuring. The board approved the distribution with no special meeting, advisor, or structural complexity. The dividend reflects ongoing shareholder return policy. What to watch: future dividend growth trajectory.
